import narwhals as nw

df = nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
result = df.to_native() if False else None  # placeholder removed below

# Apply as a "tier" column on the narwhals DataFrame `df`
df = df.with_columns(
    nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
    .then(nw.lit("gold"))
    .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
    .alias("tier")
)
